desc: The 783 features a synthetic stock built around a dual pillar bedded platform that free floats the barrel and contains a high nylon fiber content which promotes superior strength and rigidity for shot-to-shot consistency; user adjustable CrossFire trigger system; steel detachable magazine with a steel latch; accepts two Model 700 front scope bases and Supercell recoil pad. Includes scope mount, sling mounts, and magazine.
